title: Spinach, Blueberry and Farmer’s Cheese Salad
excerpt: A fresh, colorful salad with the sweet-and-tart contrast of blueberries, farmer’s cheese and toasted walnuts.
imageAlt: Baby spinach salad with fresh blueberries, cubes of farmer’s cheese, toasted walnuts and red onion

ingredients.text: 1/4 red onion, cut into thin slivers
Vinaigrette: 3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, 1 teaspoon honey, 1 teaspoon mustard, salt and pepper

steps: Toast the walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring so they don’t burn.
Make the vinaigrette by shaking all its ingredients in a jar with a lid.
In a large bowl, mix the spinach with the red onion.
Add the cheese, the blueberries and the toasted walnuts.
Dress right before serving and toss gently.
tips: Crush 5 or 6 blueberries into the vinaigrette: they add color and a very special fruity flavor.
If you make the salad ahead of time, keep the vinaigrette separate so the spinach doesn’t wilt.
